commit.body:
Make check-tests deliver its JSON envelope on stdout with quotation-pair findings and reproduce commands, without requesting a report file.

Have the ladder serialize the check-tests findings, name the generated file in its durable record, and pass that file to tests-fix. Align both contracts with the resulting handoff.
